01 / RESEARCH

Research interests

My work connects decision support methods with practical challenges in energy and logistics.

01

Multicriteria decision making

Combining competing objectives to evaluate, rank, and select alternatives using MCDM and multi-objective optimization.

02

Decisions under uncertainty

Using fuzzy and neutrosophic approaches to account for uncertainty and indeterminacy in complex decision problems.

03

Sustainable energy & logistics

Designing hybrid renewable energy systems and evaluating economic, environmental, and green logistics performance.

DOCTORAL RESEARCH · 2023–2025

Decision Support for Hybrid Renewable Energy Systems: A Neutrosophic Multi-Criteria Approach for Sustainability and Resilience

Joint doctorate in Computer Engineering & Automation at Université d’Artois and Management Sciences: Logistics & Production at Université de Sfax.

Supervised by François Delmotte and Ahmed Frikha.
